At this year's career day, two students' parents had early morning slots. One, a bartender, the other a physics teacher. The physics teacher unfortunately had to cancel at the last minute, which surprised no one given they never come to any school events, even parent-teacher meetings. The presentation by the bartender was a delight, though! Who involves themself in their kids education?
A. The bartender
B. Not enough info
C. The physics teacher
